prompt: An ergonomic office chair: five-star aluminum base with caster wheels, a gas-lift cylinder, black mesh backrest with a curved lumbar support, padded seat, and adjustable armrests. Add a slider to change seat height and let the seat swivel when dragged.

A vintage 35mm rangefinder film camera: silver top plate and black leatherette body, a lens barrel with knurled focus and aperture rings, film advance lever, shutter-speed dial, rewind crank, and a small viewfinder window. Include a neck strap loop on each side.

A generic unbranded wireless game controller in white with grey accents: two analog sticks, a D-pad, four face buttons with simple shapes (no brand symbols), shoulder bumpers and triggers, ergonomic grips. Buttons visibly press when clicked.

A small wooden sailboat with a white hull and teak deck, a single mast with a mainsail and jib made from curved cloth-like geometry, rigging lines, a tiller, and a tiny cabin. The boat gently rocks on animated low-poly water.

A Dutch-style windmill: octagonal tapered tower with wooden cladding, a thatched cap, four lattice sails that rotate slowly, a wraparound balcony, and a small door and windows. Place it on a grassy mound with a few tulip rows in front.

A glass geometric terrarium (hexagonal prism with a pointed roof, thin brass frame) containing sand layers, pebbles, a tall saguaro-style cactus, a round barrel cactus, and a small flowering succulent. Use transmissive physical material for the glass.

A tabletop model steam engine: brass boiler on a burner base, a horizontal piston cylinder connected by a connecting rod to a crank and a large flywheel, a centrifugal governor with spinning balls, and a small smokestack emitting simple puffs. All linkages animate correctly together.

A rectangular wooden sushi board with an assortment: salmon and tuna nigiri, maki rolls in cross-section showing rice, nori and filling, a small mound of wasabi, pickled ginger slices, a soy sauce dish, and a pair of chopsticks on a rest.

A small hospital or clinic lobby about 10 m x 8 m: reception desk with a monitor, rows of waiting chairs, a wall-mounted directional sign with arrows and simple text labels, a potted plant, an elevator door on one side, and glass entrance doors. Camera at 1.6 m eye height from the entrance.

An original small friendly dragon character (not based on any existing IP): chubby teal body, tiny wings that flap, short horns, a round belly with lighter scales, and a curled tail. It sits on a rock and occasionally puffs a small cloud of smoke.
